sources.entry: System Color Picker - The macOS color picker as an app with more features. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/sindresorhus/System-Color-Picker) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1545870783?platform=mac)

summary.one_liner: System Color Picker is a macOS app that extends the system color picker with extra features, distributed as a download and on the Mac App Store rather than as open source.
summary.what_it_does: The README is brief and mostly promotional, describing the app as the familiar macOS color picker "supercharged" and linking to a download. It states that the app is no longer open-source, so the repository does not provide the source code. The author says the app is still actively developed and that GitHub issues remain the channel for feature requests and bug reports. The README names three Swift libraries the app is built with: Defaults for UserDefaults handling, KeyboardShortcuts for user-customizable global shortcuts, and LaunchAtLogin for a launch-at-login option. The specific picker features are not described in the README.
use_cases: pick colors from anywhere on macOS screen
replace the built-in macOS color picker
grab hex or RGB values for design work
download a color picker app for Mac
how_to_run: Download the app from the link in the README (or the Mac App Store listing)
notable: MacOS color picker extended with more features
Built with Swift libraries for UserDefaults, global keyboard shortcuts, and launch at login
Available on the Mac App Store
Author still develops it and takes issues on GitHub
caveats: No longer open-source; the source code is not available in this repository
Feature details are not described in the README
keywords: find color hex code on mac
